brief:
Hossam Badran, a member of Hamas's political bureau and head of its national relations office, spoke by telephone with Salem Atta Allah, general secretary of the Palestinian Mujahideen movement, to review recent developments unfolding across the Palestinian arena, Shehab Wire reported. The two leaders discussed conditions in Gaza and matters related to upcoming electoral requirements facing Palestinian factions.

The conversation underscored coordination between the resistance movements on national priorities. Both organizations have previously engaged in dialogue on political arrangements and responses to developments affecting Palestinians under Israeli occupation.
